protocol.name: deck_upgrade_v1

Upgrade-progress presentation protocol for BDK-451. The compositor relays a complete display snapshot to the firmware and package overlay clients.

interface.name: deck_upgrade_v1
interface.description: Lightweight compositor-relayed IPC for upgrade overlays. Each complete snapshot starts with started and ends with snapshot_done, so a client commits only coherent state when Wayland dispatch batches several events.

event.name: started
event.description: Establish the presentation kind for the snapshot. A client must ignore following phase, progress, and terminal events until this event arrives.

event.name: phase
event.description: Report the current upgrade stage. A phase starts a new progress interval and therefore clears any prior download progress in the client snapshot. A packages snapshot carries only the package_* phases; clients treat a firmware phase in a packages snapshot as a malformed sequence.

event.name: download_progress

description.summary: download progress with an unknown total

event.description: Report bytes downloaded when no total is available. The byte count is a u64 encoded as two u32 words to preserve the full range over Wayland.

event.name: download_progress_with_total

description.summary: download progress with a known total

event.description: Report bytes downloaded and the total. Each byte count is a u64 encoded as two u32 words to preserve the full range over Wayland.

event.name: succeeded
event.description: Report success for the remaining on-screen terminal interval.

arg.name: remaining_ms
arg.summary: remaining terminal display lifetime in milliseconds

event.name: failed
event.description: Report a generic failure for the remaining on-screen terminal interval.

arg.name: remaining_ms
arg.summary: remaining terminal display lifetime in milliseconds

event.name: snapshot_done
event.description: Marks the end of a complete snapshot sequence. Clients retain their last coherent view if the candidate sequence contained invalid enum values or event ordering.
